standard_prerequisites.name: Left and right conjunction rules
standard_prerequisites.statement: Left-and derives A and B from (A and B) on the left; Right-and derives (A and B) on the right from both A and B.
standard_prerequisites.use: Item (1) uses Left-and on the initial sequents; item (2) uses Right-and on the two initial sequents A sequent A and B sequent B.

core_obligations: Statement (prop at 1006, three labels on one statement/proof span): (1) both A and B proves A and A and B proves B; (2) A, B proves A and B.
Item (1) (proof from 1014): two one-step derivations applying Left-and to the initial sequents A sequent A and B sequent B, yielding A and B sequent A and A and B sequent B.
Item (2) (proof from 1022): one derivation applying Right-and to the two initial sequents A sequent A and B sequent B, yielding A, B sequent A and B.
proof_roadmap: Witness both halves of item (1) with Left-and one-step derivations.
Witness item (2) with the Right-and binary derivation.
All sequents are derivable, so the stated facts hold.
difficulty_reason: Conjunction provability facts (statement 1006-1012, proof 1014-1032): all three one-step derivations carried in span; the bussproofs trees are the substantive content. H2.
